Live performances and Super Bowl entertainment
method: Sampled up to 250 Kalshi contracts per horizon from the published trade panel, in a fixed hash order independent of the outcome. For each sampled contract, selected the latest completed hourly candle fully within the 24 hours preceding that cutoff with trading volume, a YES trade close and both YES quotes strictly inside 0 and 1. Trade and quote closes are from the same hour and may be minutes apart. Spread is ask minus bid. The archive does not report size at these prices. Market close is the event-time anchor. Coverage favors active markets with a two-sided book. Each horizon has its own cohort. Sample sizes vary by horizon and filter. Previously validated historical rows may be reused; the refresh date marks the sample rebuild, not when every quote was first retrieved.
